Return connection metadata and setup status after verifying current native administrator authority. Credentials and setup continuation URLs are excluded. A failed read never establishes an empty collection.

post.description: Create a named server-owned connection after verifying current native administrator authority. This neither authorizes a provider account nor starts external authentication. Agent grants are checked before activation. Identical authorized retries return the same record.

get.description: Read a named connection's agent grant, state, revision, setup and cleanup status, and safe failure summary. Recheck effective native administrator authority before reading. Credentials and setup continuation URLs are never included.

patch.summary: Replace connection name and agent grant
patch.description: Replace both editable fields against the quoted current connection revision. Revocation and selected-agent changes take effect at the next broker boundary, including already pending operations.

delete.description: Revoke local use immediately and cancel pending setup. Provider cleanup is durable and may complete later. Never continue granting local use because provider deletion failed. Retain receipts and exact cleanup references.

post.description: Persist one setup attempt before requesting its hosted authentication link. Admission and permission checks use ClawScarf state; setup performs no native management. Clients poll the returned setup and navigate to its continuation URL as soon as available. Account use remains disabled until callback identity, effective native administrator authority and selected agents are verified. Only its initiating user may continue. Reconnection keeps the current active account until the exact replacement is verified. A changed retry payload conflicts; uncertain setup creation is not blindly replayed. New attempts and provider preparation/allocation require the current published catalog. Authentication preparation has its own durable receipt; an uncertain preparation or allocation blocks replacement until resolved.

get.summary: Read or continue a setup attempt
get.description: Return current setup and its unexpired continuation URL only to the initiating user with current native administrator authority. This read never redeems a callback, creates an account or restarts expired setup.

delete.description: Idempotently cancel this exact setup attempt and schedule provider cleanup. A late callback cannot activate it. Completed setup cannot be cancelled; disconnect the connection explicitly.

post.description: Observe the exact bound provider account after verifying native administrator authority and current revision. The initiator may finish an unexpired setup from a durably recorded identity receipt. Never redeem the callback again or infer identity from account status alone.

Installation credential and trusted native agent context select currently permitted exact connections. Human cookies and CLI credentials are not accepted. No server identity is accepted in the payload.

defaultModel.description: Retained for response compatibility; always null. The installation selects a model for each inference request.

session.name: __Host-clawscarf-session
session.description: SDK sealed session; localhost uses clawscarf-session.

InstallationManagement.description: Installation management credential; owner and runtime credentials are rejected.

InstallationRuntime.description: Revocable runtime credential scoped to one installation.

Maintenance.description: Server-side CRON_SECRET only; no installation credential.

Inference.description: ClawScarf-issued, revocable installation AI credential. Never an OpenRouter credential.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code; clients tolerate additional codes.

detail.description: Safe explanation without raw provider diagnostics or secrets.

requestId.description: Request correlation ID for operator diagnostics.

RetryGuidance.description: Retry advice does not authorize replaying a mutation. Preserve idempotency keys and reconcile uncertain outcomes.

strategy.description:
never means no automatic replay; after_change requires a corrected
request or changed prerequisite; reconcile means inspect the original
command outcome before deciding whether another attempt is safe.

afterSeconds.description: Only when a retry time is known; consistent with Retry-After when provided.

Connection.description: Current authorized connection state for this server.

Id.description: Opaque identifier; clients must not infer identity or provider details from it.

ConnectorAgentGrant.description: All includes future native agents. Selected uses exact IDs; missing IDs never widen the grant.

ConnectionSetupContinuation.description: Only the initiating user with current native-administrator admission may obtain the unexpired setup URL. URLs contain provider capabilities and must not be logged or included in ordinary list responses.

ConnectorRuntimeContext.description: Populated by the trusted native plugin factory, never by model arguments. Calls require sessionId or sessionKey. Installation identity comes only from the machine credential.

guidance.description: Present only when this agent has no usable connections before applying search filters. The URL identifies the authenticated server; it grants no portal access. Managing connections requires the signed-in person's current native administrator permission.

inputSchema.description: Opaque provider schema hint or JSON data. Never use it as a transport validator.

outputSchema.description: Opaque provider schema hint or JSON data. Never use it as a transport validator.

arguments.description: Generic JSON object. Provider input schemas are advisory and are not enforced or repaired. Serialized arguments are limited to 128 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. The complete HTTP request body is limited to 256 KiB.

ConnectorRuntimeCall.description: Durable invocation identity is scoped to server credential, native session and toolCallId. Identical replay returns the existing receipt; changed arguments conflict. Never automatically redispatch an uncertain call. Exact connection generation and catalog action version must still be current.

ConnectorRuntimeInvocation.description: Execution state and idempotency survive result expiry. Results are retained for 24 hours after completion. JSON above the 32 KiB inline limit is read through bounded result pages. Expired or unavailable data never changes a succeeded execution to failure or permits a new dispatch.

ConnectorResultPage.description: Exact UTF-8 JSON text, at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes per page. Join page text in byte-offset order and verify the reference byte length and SHA-256 to recover the complete serialized result. No page is an independent JSON document. Cursor is a selector, not authorization; every page rechecks current access.

ConnectorRuntimeInvocationLookup.description: Read only. Find the receipt for the original tool call in the current native agent/session. Missing receipts return 404 and never allocate or execute an invocation. Native context is supplied by the plugin, not model parameters.

ConnectionReturnDestination.description: Current authorized connection state for this server.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid JSON, field or request shape; code invalid_request.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid session or runtime credential; code unauthenticated.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated caller lacks the required current authority; code forbidden.

NotFound.description: Resource absent or not accessible in the server; code not_found.

Conflict.description: The command conflicts with current state or a previous idempotent request.

PreconditionFailed.description: The observed resource revision is stale; code revision_conflict.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds this route's configured body limit; code request_too_large.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Request body must use application/json; code unsupported_media_type.

InternalError.description: Safe failure response; no provider payload, stack trace or credential is exposed.

IdempotencyKey.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable for one logical request; scoped by server, actor and operation kind.

ConnectionRevision.name: if-match
ConnectionRevision.description: Quoted current connection revision, for example "3". Applies to the connection record, not the installation or provider configuration.

AdministratorAssertion.name: x-clawscarf-administrator
AdministratorAssertion.description: Base64url JSON from trusted installation Access after checking current native administrator authority: userId, sessionHash, verifiedAt, agentIds and the installation browser origin. Never accepted directly from a browser.
